title: I asked ChatGPT to “Create an illustration of mallworld”,
content: that was it… I was extremely vague and didn’t input any other specific details and I am absolutely speechless at how similar their first attempt at creating an image is of my dreams. This was the first image and it has got so many of the specific details right, it has genuinely freaked me out. For example one significant aspect of my mallworld location that pops up time and time again, is the hotel lobby with a kind of tropical neon signage. I have never even told anyone else this specific detail. Another eerie detail is the fact they have included the river and mountains, and even airplanes. These are such significant elements of my mallworld landscape. There are some parts that are not quite right. Like for example the car on one of the upper floors isn’t correct. Love to hear your thoughts on this interpretation of mallworld.
